status: FROZEN (design); input bindings to WP2/WP3 artifacts recorded at WP4 start
objective: Determine how known bar structure changes the anchor (context at the anchor) and how structural detectors evolve after the anchor, including joint price/detector sequencing, per plan §7, on the development leaf only.

bar_availability_clock.rule: a bar's payload becomes lawful at the received_ts_ns/source_sequence of the first tick whose event time enters a later bucket (established sidecar convention); bar_close_ts is the temporal boundary only
bar_availability_clock.implementation: the scanner streams ticks and bars together; for each anchor, the lawful snapshot per scale is the latest bar whose availability (received_ts, source_sequence) is strictly before the anchor's availability; else missing
bar_availability_clock.native_scale: every object keeps its scale label; scales are never merged into one population

location_and_zones.at_anchor: inside/outside, boundary relation, direction, age, normalized distance
location_and_zones.post_anchor: first touch, fill, break, boundary interaction, object termination where lawful

structural_transition.at_anchor: latest direction, transition age, distance to known pivot
structural_transition.post_anchor: new swing, BOS/CHOCH, local-structure transition, transition latency

liquidity.at_anchor: side, distance, nearest lawful source, active relation
liquidity.post_anchor: interaction, removal, migration, newly lawful state transition

normalization.post_anchor: normalization-regime change only; not an independent event signal

lineage.at_anchor: dependency control, not an independent vote

step_0_payload_inventory.purpose: inventory every field of the 16 bar-detector payloads per scale from a deterministic development-leaf sample before behavioral scans
step_0_payload_inventory.output: AP-001/R4_STRUCTURAL_CONTEXT/AP-001_WP4_PAYLOAD_DICTIONARY.json — per detector per scale: fields, types, state-vs-event classification, availability semantics
step_0_payload_inventory.rule: fields without lawful availability semantics are excluded from anchor-time conditioning and marked

question_A_context_at_anchor.snapshot: at each WP2 anchor, the lawful latest bar payload per scale per family, per the availability clock
contrasts: near vs far from lawful structural boundary (normalized distance bands)
aligned vs opposed to structural direction
question_A_context_at_anchor.outcomes_conditioned: same outcome set as WP3 question class A (lifecycle + market)
question_A_context_at_anchor.output: AP-001/R4_STRUCTURAL_CONTEXT/AP-001_WP4_CONDITIONING_TABLES.json with support, blocks, effect vs WP2 reference, INSUFFICIENT_SUPPORT per reference rules

question_B_structural_evolution_after_an.window: post-anchor until episode end or +300s, whichever first
measurements: first structural transition per family per scale

question_C_joint_sequencing.definition: ordered path per anchor: Drift-Burst anchor -> price movement -> other-detector transitions -> Drift-Burst transitions -> later price movement; records event order and latency, assumes no causality
measurements: event order table (price excursion vs structural transition vs tick-family transition vs Drift-Burst transition)
recurring sequence mining within predeclared length cap (<= 4 events, family-level resolution)
cross-block recurrence of mined sequences (month blocks)
dependency/lineage guard: dependent detectors (raw3 derivatives) collapsed into one information family for confluence counts
question_C_joint_sequencing.reanchor_candidates: recurring post-anchor events are LISTED for prospective re-anchor in their own lawful study; not treated as anchor-time information

exit_condition: Report states which contexts matter, which detector-system sequences recur, which do not, and which lack support; payload dictionary complete; lineage notes recorded; determinism hashes match.
interpretation_boundary: Tables frozen, then interpreted. No candidate promotion in WP4; the candidate shortlist goes to the director promotion gate, then WP5.
change_rule: Deviations require decision-log entries and director approval before affected evidence is used.
